name: EPIC 245922080
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 11.3 solar radii and 0.82 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245922080 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.281064 (16th-84th percentiles 10.924306-11.834838), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,544 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.82 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,789 K at its surface.
